item.title: unc0ver v5.2.0
item.description:
unc0ver 5.2.0 | unc0ver_5.2.0
Last updated at: 06/09/2020
06/09/2020 - v5.2.0 was released for production with the following changes:
### ⚠️ Support development with https://phonerebel.com ⚠️
- Enable iOS 13.5.5~b1 support - Fix a logic bug in disabling auto updates - Update bundled Cydia to fix crashes on iOS 13.5 with Hardware Keyboard enabled
